newsitem.title: USA: D.R. Horton issues $150 million in debt.
newsitem.headline: D.R. Horton issues $150 million in debt.

text.p: The following debt issue from D.R. Horton Inc was priced on Wednesday, according to lead manager Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities.
The issue was priced as a variable price reoffering. Underwriters would not release levels.

In May, the company filed a shelf registration for $250 million. It said proceeds would be used for general corporate purposes including development of non-residential properties, acquisitions and repayment of existing debt.
D.R. Horton, based in Arlington, Texas, is a builder of single family homes in metropolitan areas of the Mid-Atlantic,
Midwest, Southeast and Western regions of the United States.
